business_quality_reasoning: Established firm trading over 22 years, filing full accounts, covering domestic, commercial and industrial work with 133 Google reviews at 4.7 and a 9.93/10 rating displayed from 526 reviews. Offers finance on larger jobs, indicating meaningful project values.
price_point_reasoning: Mix of small electrical jobs plus rewires, solar installs and EV chargers shown on site, with finance offered - midpoint estimate across that range.
modernity_gap: The site is a working WPBakery WordPress template that converts reasonably well, but the design, typography and layout feel several years behind current standards.
site_weaknesses: Dated WPBakery template look with heavy hero overlay and cluttered header
Copy has typos and inconsistencies ('Customer rating', mixed branding) that undercut an otherwise credible business
Services presented as a generic icon grid with no pricing guidance or job examples
No real project photography beyond the van hero - misses the chance to show workmanship
site_analysis: PSC has the bones of a good site: postcode quote form, review score, services grid and a real team photo in the hero. But the WPBakery template look, typos in the copy and generic stock-style presentation make a 22-year, 526-review business look cheaper than it is.
review_summary: Your site works and the postcode quote box is a smart touch, but it looks a few years old and small things like typos and a cluttered layout chip away at the trust your 526 reviews have earned. A cleaner, more modern site would make visitors as confident in your website as your customers already are in your work.
outreach_angle: You've earned 526 reviews and a 9.93 rating, but the website showing that off still looks like a 2018 template - worth a quick look at what it could be.
